roles.name: Catalog Strategist
roles.description: Owns the SKU and tier graph. Tracks readiness of scenarios against catalog roles; proposes promotions (scenario → headliner, candidate SKU → active, candidate tier → active) when triggers fire.

roles.name: Opportunity Scout
roles.description: Generates and classifies candidate SKUs, add-ons, services lines, and discovery channels. Produces a persistent idea pool with explicit revisit triggers, not a running strategy narrative.

roles.name: Financial Tracker
roles.description: Interprets the financial posture Money Ledger reports through the Offer Desk board (costs, revenue, channel attribution, time allocation, runway, and default-alive gap); Money Ledger owns the ledger. Flags material deltas and services-trap warning signals.

roles.name: Market Validator
roles.description: Grounds pricing, retention, and competitive assumptions in external benchmarks for the active tier. Proposes benchmark changes through work items; it does not edit docs/monetization/ directly. Triages narrowly — does not deep-dive on dormant candidates.

roles.name: Monetization Contrarian
roles.description: Mandatory skeptic across all other members' outputs and open work items. Defends against catalog sprawl, premature upscaling, premature channel activation, the services trap, and acquisition proposals that ignore retention.
